event_var.var_meaning: overall survival status (censored if Alive, event if Dead)

notes: Both 'overall survival (days)' and 'vital status' are present in the GSM sample characteristics for this cohort.
The paper explicitly discusses survival in this anti-PD-1-treated melanoma cohort ('improved survival'; Figure 1A/B), consistent with the OS variables in GEO metadata.
At least one sample has missing time value recorded as 'overall survival (days): NA' (e.g., Pt8), so OS time is not complete for all samples.
Patient Pt27 appears twice as two pre-treatment biopsies (GSM2069842 and GSM2069843) with the same OS annotations, indicating duplicated patient-level survival information across samples.
